title: ready.php response
description: Readiness. Probes the database (SELECT 1), OpenAI (authenticated GET /v1/models) and Langfuse (GET /api/public/health), each bounded to 2 s, result cached 60 s. HTTP 503 with status=not_ready if database or openai fails; HTTP 200 with status=degraded if only langfuse fails; HTTP 200 status=ready otherwise. No authentication; reveals no key validity or quota state.

dependencies.description: Per-dependency result: 'ok' or a short failure reason.

contracts.description: Week 2: the module's own runtime pieces, the JSON Schema validator library and the contract files; required, because without them every sidecar reply and every model call fails.

sidecar.description: Week 2: GET /ready on the sidecar (its own local dependencies). Optional like langfuse: down means 'degraded' (documents cannot be extracted, questions are answered from facts only), never 'not_ready', because briefings do not need it.

degraded.description: Optional dependencies that failed. Only langfuse is optional.

checked_at.description: When the probes actually ran (ISO 8601 UTC).

age_seconds.description: Seconds since checked_at; up to 60 when served from cache.
